title: Big CP2 quantum-cohomology LG coverings near the equianharmonic lattice
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The construction coordinates an inverse Gauss–Manin period map, deformed modular functions, canonical-coordinate expansions from Gromov–Witten invariants, and isomonodromic lattice uniformization. All coordinate-construction and coefficient cores are retained, so the task is not merely substitution in the final Weierstrass formula; the small model and its deformations are counted together.
author: Guilherme F. Almeida
